quote-runtime

Usage:
  quote-runtime <command> [flags]

Global flags:
  --json
  --org-alias <alias>
  --fail-on <status>
  --output <path>
  --verbose

Preflight and command fit:
  doctor

Persisted snapshots and overlays:
  snapshot-quote
  snapshot-lines
  overlay-actions
  overlay-relationships

Context and planning:
  inspect-pricing-waterfall
  capture-post-pst-evidence
  classify-pricing-outcome
  create-quote
  upsert-quote-lines
  price-quote
  build-test-quote
  discover-products
  inspect-usage-rate-model
  inspect-pricing-product-sync
  deploy-product-catalog-index
  refresh-decision-tables
  inspect-quote-ready-product
  inspect-product-catalog-config
  plan-product-config
  apply-configured-quote
  pst-apply-quote-intent
  inspect-product-config
  validate-product-config
  repair-product-config
  inspect-rlm-context
  pst-plan
  compare-quote-pricing
  triage-symptom
  explain-price
  explain-missing-price
  verify-lifecycle-provenance
  test-pricing-change
  create-lifecycle-scenario
  inspect-asset-lifecycle
  plan-order-activation
  activate-order
  capture-post-activation-evidence

Quick starts:
  quote-runtime doctor --org-alias <alias> --for-command doctor
  quote-runtime doctor --org-alias <alias> --for-command snapshot-quote --quote-id <id>
  quote-runtime snapshot-quote --org-alias <alias> --quote-id <id>
  quote-runtime snapshot-lines --org-alias <alias> --quote-id <id> --line-id <id>
  quote-runtime overlay-actions --org-alias <alias> --quote-id <id>
  quote-runtime overlay-relationships --org-alias <alias> --quote-id <id> --line-id <id>
  quote-runtime inspect-pricing-waterfall --org-alias <alias> --quote-id <id> --line-id <id>
  quote-runtime capture-post-pst-evidence --org-alias <alias> --quote-id <id> --line-id <id> --line-id <id>
  quote-runtime classify-pricing-outcome --org-alias <alias> --quote-id <id> --line-id <id> --expected-change <text>
  quote-runtime create-quote --org-alias <alias> --name <name> --quote-account-id <id> --opportunity-id <id> --pricebook-id <id>
  quote-runtime upsert-quote-lines --org-alias <alias> --quote-id <id> --pricebook-entry-id <id> --product-id <id> --quantity <number>
  quote-runtime price-quote --org-alias <alias> --quote-id <id> --line-id <id> --line-field Quantity=2
  quote-runtime build-test-quote --org-alias <alias> --input quote-intent.json
  quote-runtime discover-products --org-alias <alias> --pricebook-id <id> --term "DR suite"
  quote-runtime inspect-usage-rate-model --org-alias <alias> --include-samples
  quote-runtime inspect-pricing-product-sync --org-alias <alias>
  quote-runtime deploy-product-catalog-index --org-alias <alias>
  quote-runtime refresh-decision-tables --org-alias <alias> --decision-table-api-name <name>
  quote-runtime inspect-quote-ready-product --org-alias <alias> --pricebook-id <id> --term "DR suite"
  quote-runtime inspect-product-catalog-config --org-alias <alias> --product-id <id> --pricebook-id <id>
  quote-runtime plan-product-config --org-alias <alias> --product-config product-config.json --choices choices.json
  quote-runtime apply-configured-quote --org-alias <alias> --quote-intent quote-intent.json --config-plan config-plan.json
  quote-runtime pst-apply-quote-intent --org-alias <alias> --input quote-intent.json
  quote-runtime inspect-product-config --org-alias <alias> --quote-id <id> --line-id <id>
  quote-runtime validate-product-config --org-alias <alias> --quote-id <id> --line-id <id>
  quote-runtime repair-product-config --org-alias <alias> --quote-id <id> --line-id <id> --repair-plan repair-plan.json
  quote-runtime inspect-rlm-context --org-alias <alias> --quote-id <id> --line-id <id>
  quote-runtime pst-plan --org-alias <alias> --operation-family initiate_amendment --quote-id <id>
  quote-runtime compare-quote-pricing --org-alias <alias> --before-quote-id <id> --after-quote-id <id>
  quote-runtime triage-symptom --org-alias <alias> --quote-id <id> --symptom "wrong price" --line-id <id>
  quote-runtime explain-price --org-alias <alias> --quote-id <id> --line-id <id> --expected-change "line should use the discounted renewal price"
  quote-runtime explain-missing-price --org-alias <alias> --quote-id <id> --line-id <id>
  quote-runtime verify-lifecycle-provenance --org-alias <alias> --quote-id <id> --line-id <id> --asset-id <id>
  quote-runtime test-pricing-change --org-alias <alias> --quote-id <id> --changed-artifact <text> --expected-change <text>
  quote-runtime create-lifecycle-scenario --org-alias <alias> --operation-family initiate_amendment --quote-id <id> --asset-id <id>
  quote-runtime inspect-asset-lifecycle --org-alias <alias> --asset-id <id>
  quote-runtime plan-order-activation --org-alias <alias> --order-id <id>
  quote-runtime activate-order --org-alias <alias> --order-id <id> --execute
  quote-runtime capture-post-activation-evidence --org-alias <alias> --order-id <id>

Notes:
  Installed workspace binary `quote-runtime` is the canonical operator path in this repo.
  The skill-local TS script remains a repo-local implementation detail and compatibility fallback.
  Product discovery/config inspection is deterministic; transcript interpretation remains agent-owned.
  inspect-rlm-context is an escalation lane and stays summary-first; it does not replace persisted snapshots.
